articles.title: Sun Life Adjusts Fund Lineup And DentaQuest Leadership As Stock Screens Cheap
articles.mainIdea: Sun Life Adjusts Fund Lineup And DentaQuest Leadership As Stock Screens Cheap
articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: Sun Life Adjusts Fund Lineup And DentaQuest Leadership As Stock Screens Cheap. Sun Life Financial (TSX:SLF) is changing sub-advisory roles on certain mutual funds, moving responsibilities from BlackRock to State Street. The company is also rebranding the affected mutual funds to reflect the new sub-advisory structure. Separately, Sun Life's DentaQuest business has appointed a new dental director for Texas. articles.title: BlackRock Private Credit Write Down Puts Valuations And Dividend Risks In Focus
articles.mainIdea: BlackRock Private Credit Write Down Puts Valuations And Dividend Risks In Focus
articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: BlackRock Private Credit Write Down Puts Valuations And Dividend Risks In Focus. BlackRock reported a 19% net asset value decline in its publicly traded private credit fund, BlackRock TCP Capital Corp., driven mainly by issuer specific issues. The write down has sharpened attention on risk controls and valuation practices across the broader private credit market. Regulators and investors are focusing more closely on how managers assess and report the value of less liquid credit holdings.
